stories.title: LAPP India to Highlight Rail Connectivity Solutions at InnoRail
stories.summary: LAPP India will showcase railway-approved cable and connectivity solutions at InnoRail 2026 in Lucknow from November 26 to 28, 2026. The company aims to demonstrate products for signaling, rolling stock, and fire-performance applications to support India's railway modernization.

stories.title: Why Amazon’s 1.2M-square-foot plant could cement Austin’s reputation as a robotics builder
stories.summary: Amazon began core-and-shell construction on a 1.2-million-square-foot robotics plant in Austin, Texas, with a scheduled completion date of July 13, 2027. The facility, located on the Dog’s Head tract, will produce robotics systems for repetitive tasks and heavy lifting, creating 300 to 500 roles without seeking public incentives.

stories.title: Urban rail industry news round-up
stories.summary: The Hanoi Metropolitan Railway Management Board signed a turnkey contract with a Vinhomes and Vingroup joint venture to deliver five metro lines totaling 267 km. Alstom began manufacturing 32 driverless metro cars for Chennai Metro Phase II under a €135m contract that includes 15 years of maintenance.

stories.title: Why Britain's Â£142 Million Underwater Drone Fleet Changes Sea Warfare
stories.summary: The Royal Navy signed a £142 million contract with HII for REMUS 620 unmanned underwater vehicles, automated launch and recovery gear, and support services under its Mine-Hunting Capability program. These autonomous submarines dive up to 600 meters, reach speeds of eight knots, and operate for up to 110 hours, integrating with UK-developed SeeByte SeeTrack and Neptune software to support the Royal Navy's Hybrid Navy concept.

stories.title: Japan’s Humanoid Robot Restart in 2026: From HRP Heritage to the Factory Floor
stories.summary: Kawada Technologies began operational trials in November 2025 of its modernized HRP-2 humanoid robot at Kawada Construction’s Construction Equipment Center to test sorting and transporting bridge components. Highlanders signed a memorandum of understanding with Mitsubishi Motors in July to study mass-producing its N humanoid at Mitsubishi’s Kyoto Plant, with production potentially beginning in early 2027.

Report Urges Massachusetts to Regulate Driverless Cars
stories.summary: Jamey Tesler released a report recommending that MassDOT receive a formal designation from the governor as the lead regulatory agency for autonomous vehicles. The report also recommends dedicating staff to autonomous vehicle regulation and setting testing permits with reporting requirements.

The qualification allows the company to compete for federal testing, training, and experimentation projects but does not guarantee a contract, project funding, or purchases by the Canadian Armed Forces or Canadian Coast Guard.

stories.title: Taiwan accelerates domestic drone procurement with unlocked defense budgets
stories.summary: Taiwan began accelerating commission-production and commercial procurement programs for defense-related unmanned vehicles following the gradual unlocking of defense budgets in the latter half of 2026.

stories.title: EU to step up eastern border defenses with rapid response force, counter-drone capabilities
stories.summary: European Commissioner for Internal Affairs and Migration Magnus Brunner announced Tuesday that the EU is strengthening eastern border security with a proposed rapid reaction force, enhanced counter-drone capabilities, and tighter visa restrictions. He stated that €500 million is available for border surveillance and counter-drone measures, while €50 million will accelerate a maritime security hub in the Black Sea. Brunner also noted that the EU updated guidelines Monday to require additional documentation from Russian visa applicants and that a revision of the EU visa code early next year will introduce targeted restrictions against nationals of hostile third countries.

stories.title: Citizens Maintains Uber’s Outperform Rating, Sees Growth Potential in Autonomous Vehicles
stories.summary: Nuro, Lucid, and Uber launched fully driverless testing on public roads in the San Francisco Bay Area, removing onboard safety operators after months of supervised tests. Internal rides will begin soon, with public service expected to launch in the first quarter of 2027.

stories.title: AI-Powered Robotics and Automation Transforming Manufacturing in 2026
stories.summary: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai opened the Robotics Metaplant Application Center in Georgia, USA, in September 2026 to train Atlas robots for parts logistics and component handling. Hexagon Robotics and Schaeffler plan to deploy at least 1,000 AEON humanoid units across Schaeffler factories in the coming years.

stories.title: Samsung Humanoid: “20 Motors in One Hand” ... Robot-Hand Value Chain Gains Momentum
stories.summary: Samsung Electronics plans to unveil a humanoid robot at CES 2027 in Las Vegas, featuring 20 motors in each hand and hinge technology from foldable smartphones. Daesung Hi-Tech, ICH, and Unichem are expanding into robotics components, with Unichem acquiring Loomia Technologies for up to $6.3 million to develop tactile sensing.

Tesla launches self-driving car with added AI-powered traffic simulation technology.
stories.summary: Tesla has begun rolling out version 15 of its Full Self-Driving (Supervised) driver assistance system, featuring a new Reality View function that displays a live simulation of the traffic environment using artificial intelligence ( AI ). CEO Elon Musk said the update comprehensively improves the control system, with its ability to handle safety-critical situations increasing 25-fold.

stories.title: Florida Moves Toward Air Taxi Service as Manufacturers Test Aircraft and Airports Study Vertiports
stories.summary: Joby Aviation began a week-long campaign of piloted electric air taxi flights across Florida on 30 October 2026, in partnership with the Florida Department of Transportation.

stories.title: FeralX and Great North Aviation Form 'Feral North' Partnership for ISR and Heavy-Lift Drone Missions
stories.summary: FeralX Systems Inc. announced Feral North, a partnership with Great North Aviation to deliver intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance, cargo and equipment to remote locations in Canada and allied countries. The five-year agreement, effective November 23, 2026, combines Great North's Dash 8 fleet with FeralX's uncrewed aircraft for missions including wildfire response and northern logistics.

Army Patents Filament That Doubles 3D-Printed Drone Body Strength
Motional's CES self-driving demo crucial to reviving market confidence
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor needs a convincing autonomous driving breakthrough at CES 2027 to restore investor confidence, as mounting earnings pressure and its lagging position in self-driving technology leave the automaker struggling to justify its ambitious future mobility investments.

stories.title: Ukraine is now a drone superpower at sea, on land, and in the air
stories.summary: Ukrainian naval drones sank a Russian warship at the port of Benghazi in Libya and struck a cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland. These attacks demonstrate Ukraine's expanding geographical reach and its status as a world leader in drone warfare.

stories.title: The Age of the Unmanned Battlefield: Ukraine Is Rewriting the Rules of War on Land and Sea
stories.summary: Ukrainian company SkyFall developed the StarGate aerial drone, which has completed eight evacuations, including the extraction of soldier Eugen from a position five kilometres from the Russian border. Maritime drones destroyed the Russian corvette Merkury at a naval base in Libya, more than 1,500 kilometres from Ukraine’s coastline.

Westborough Drafts a Zoning Drone Ban Before Amazon Files Again
stories.summary: Westborough’s Planning Board voted on November 23 to advance a zoning amendment prohibiting unmanned aircraft systems in all districts, following a 510-to-13 town meeting vote banning commercial drone pads. The board requested a special town meeting and set a public hearing for December 15, while Amazon has stated it will file a revised project after withdrawing its October 30 application.

stories.title: EUROCAE Publishes ED-286A Counter-Drone Standard for Airports
stories.summary: European aviation standards body EUROCAE published ED-286A, which defines counter-drone system operations in controlled airspace and replaces the March 2021 ED-286 standard. The update adds scenarios, use cases, and risk assessment guidelines for airport and air navigation providers.

stories.title: Austria Is Urgently Setting Up a National Drone Defense System
stories.summary: Austria is developing a new drone defense system scheduled to become operational in 2027. The plan calls for the creation of a drone monitoring center, the procurement of new countermeasures, and the strengthening of critical infrastructure protection.

California High-Speed Rail Reports Central Valley Construction Progress, Ballast Deliveries
stories.summary: The California High-Speed Rail Authority is preparing to lay track in Kern County after completing the 6,333-foot Hanford Viaduct in Kings County and advancing grade separations in Fresno.

stories.title: Trucking Tightens as Rail Volume Surges
stories.summary: National truckload tender rejections climbed to 13.68%, roughly double the level from a year ago, while intermodal rates run 29.6% below truckload contract rates. BNSF filed formal opposition to the Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern merger, citing more than 310 errors in the traffic analysis.

stories.title: Braiin Plans $40 Million Deal For India's Marut Drones
stories.summary: Nasdaq-listed Braiin Limited signed a non-binding term sheet to acquire a majority stake in Hyderabad-based Marut Drones for approximately $40 million. The phased deal includes eight DGCA type certificates, seven pilot training schools, and more than 100 dealers, integrating Marut into Braiin’s Robotics and AI division.

stories.title: Precision Joint Actuators for the Next Generation of Humanoid and Quadruped Robots
stories.summary: Hangzhou Liangzhi Joint Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures precision planetary and harmonic gearboxes for humanoid and quadruped robots, offering standard modules with peak torque up to 600 Nm and weights of approximately 4.1 kg. The company, founded in 2025, operates manufacturing bases in Pinghu and Dalingshan with a combined planned annual capacity of approximately 300,000 joint actuators.

FireAnt Mini Uncrewed Ground Vehicles Deploy Drone Detection Sensors In U.S. Army Test
stories.summary: A FireAnt uncrewed ground vehicle deployed small sensors capable of detecting hostile drones during a U.S. Army test exercise. The event, NANO ACE II, took place in October at the Multidomain Training Area in Tan-Tan, Morocco.

stories.title: Waymo and Tesla Test Robotaxis in Detroit Ahead of Michigan Winter
stories.summary: Waymo plans to open robotaxi rides to the public in Detroit in 2027, the company told Axios Detroit on Thursday, Nov. 19. No launch date has been picked. Testing without human safety drivers began in October. Before that, specialists sat behind the wheel for several months. Now the company is preparing for its first winter in the city with no one driving, WXYZ reported when that phase began. Detroit has become a testing ground for rival robotaxi systems. Michigan's winters could change how fast either one grows. Tesla has joined the local testing. About two dozen gold Cybercabs run out of a Southfield facility, according to the Detroit News. Waymo's cars have no one at the wheel, but the Cybercabs do. Human test drivers steer them with temporary steering wheels. Snow, ice, and freezing temperatures make driving harder for everyone, and robotaxis are no exception. Their sensors can struggle when the weather turns bad. Henry Liu leads the University of Michigan's Mcity autonomous vehicle research center. He told Axios that winter weather is a "manageable challenge" for driverless vehicles, but that it makes running them more complicated. Waymo says its latest technology has heated sensors, micro-wipers, and systems that identify changes in road traction. Safety questions are piling up for the company across the country. California regulators banned its driverless vehicles from freeways after incidents near construction zones and highway patrol vehicles. Waymo then stopped fully driverless freeway trips in all of its markets. Spokesperson Chris Bonelli told Axios the pause won't touch Detroit, since the company hadn't started driverless freeway trips there yet.

stories.title: Poland sent Russia a "strongly worded note" over a drone's violation of its airspace
stories.summary: Poland accused Moscow of deliberately violating its airspace after a Russian reconnaissance drone briefly crossed the border. The Russian ambassador was summoned and handed a "note in a sharp tone."

stories.title: Former Skeptic Seaport Analyst Upgrades Tesla to Buy, Cites Multitrillion-Dollar Robotaxi Potential
stories.summary: Seaport analyst Ron Jewsikow initiated coverage of Tesla on Tuesday, naming the stock a buy with a price target implying 25% growth. He cited the robotaxi business as a "legitimate multitrillion-dollar opportunity," estimating it could generate $2 billion to $4 billion in annual recurring revenue by the end of next year.

also.title: Tesla’s Robotaxi Business Could Generate $3-4B In Annual Recurring Revenue By 2027-End, Says Seaport Global

stories.title: NASA takes ownership of X-59 as quiet supersonic flight moves closer to reality
stories.summary: NASA took ownership of the X-59 quiet supersonic research aircraft from Lockheed Martin Skunk Works on 18 November, following an acceptance review. The agency will now conduct acoustic validation flights to determine if the aircraft can fly supersonically without producing loud sonic booms, with the program scheduled to run through 2029.

also.title: Lockheed Martin Delivers X-59 Supersonic Jet to NASA Following Flight Tests Above Mach 1.5

stories.title: Russian drone strikes civilian car in Sumy: 76-year-old man killed
stories.summary: A 76-year-old man was killed when an enemy FPV drone with a fibre-optic control system struck a civilian car in the Kovpakivskyi district of Sumy on 24 November. Serhii Kryvosheienko, Head of Sumy City Military Administration, stated the man's son was driving and survived, and is currently in hospital.

stories.title: Sreedharan says Kerala semi-high-speed rail project will require less funding than constructing new tracks
Japan encourages auto suppliers to make components for military drones — Defense News
stories.summary: Japan's Acquisition, Technology and Logistics Agency launched an October program to finance the development and testing of new military technologies, encouraging auto-parts manufacturers to create components for unmanned aerial vehicles. The agency is prepared to allocate millions of dollars to projects that reach the prototype development stage.

stories.title: Accu Says Metric Fasteners Are A US Drone Production Bottleneck
stories.summary: Accu Components says metric fasteners are a bottleneck in US drone production, noting that US drones rely on M2 to M5 hardware while the domestic industry is geared to imperial sizes. The company reported that drone spend more than tripled between its 2023 and 2025 financial years, and it opened its first US distribution centre in Indianapolis, Indiana, in May 2026.

stories.title: Indiana Opens 224-Mile Drone Airspace Corridor
stories.summary: Purdue University and state defense partners established a 224-mile-long, 15-mile-wide airspace corridor across western Indiana for uncrewed aircraft testing. The inaugural demonstration took place at Terre Haute Regional Airport on October 29, 2026, where a Windracers ULTRA aircraft completed a beyond-visual-line-of-sight flight.

stories.title: Turkish Kizilelma Fighter Drone Declared Operational
stories.summary: Turkish drone manufacturer Baykar announced that the first three Bayraktar Kizilelma uncrewed combat aircraft have entered the inventory of Turkish security forces following acceptance testing. The company describes this as the first operational induction of an uncrewed fighter jet anywhere in the world, with the program accumulating approximately 600 test and training sorties.

stories.title: NATO Trains F-16s and NASAMS on Real Target Drones in the Baltics
stories.summary: NATO Allied Air Command ran three days of counter-drone training in the Baltic region from November 17 to 19, using real drones as targets. Belgian and Turkish F-16s, Finnish F/A-18 Hornets, Italian Eurofighters, and Lithuania’s NASAMS surface-to-air missile system participated in the mission.

stories.title: Rail Merger Risks Soaring Costs for Small Shippers
stories.summary: Eric Byer, CEO of the Alliance for Chemical Distribution, stated that the proposed Union Pacific–Norfolk Southern merger risks consolidating 40% to 46% of U.S. rail freight, threatening small shippers with limited competition. Byer assessed the odds of blocking the deal as a 50/50 or 60/40 chance in opponents' favor, noting that the Surface Transportation Board has requested additional information and is leaning toward rejection.

stories.title: Transport minister defends new land seizure powers proposed for high-speed rail
stories.summary: Transport Minister Steven MacKinnon defended new land seizure powers proposed for a high-speed rail project between Toronto and Quebec City. The draft legislation would allow Ottawa to fast-track steps and bar sale or work on property for years, building on a June law that enabled expropriation without public hearings.

also.title: Ottawa to lock down property rights for high-speed rail project

stories.title: Silynxcom (NYSE American: SYNX) Targets Growing Blind Spot in Drone Defense with Wearable Acoustic Detection
stories.summary: Silynxcom is developing a wearable acoustic drone-detection system that uses artificial intelligence to recognize drone acoustic signatures and provide real-time alerts to the wearer.

stories.title: Tesla Robotaxi Surpasses 6 Million Miles on Its Live Counter
stories.summary: Tesla's live Robotaxi counter surpassed 6 million estimated autonomous miles on November 24, while its latest safety report covers 3.1 million miles from January 22 through October 18. The company reported zero injuries in collisions where its Robotaxi made first contact during that measured period, with Austin accounting for about 2.1 million miles.

stories.title: Waymo says recall prompted by 11 new incidents of robotaxis entering closed freeway lanes
stories.summary: Waymo recalled nearly 4,500 U.S. self-driving vehicles after 11 incidents of robotaxis entering closed freeway lanes since Oct. 1, including three on Nov. 9. The company is still working on the recall remedy, while a separate manual traffic recall was completed on Nov. 6.

Walmart’s Robot Warehouse Partner Symbotic Just Had Its First Profitable Year
stories.summary: Symbotic reported its first full year of GAAP profitability with net income of $133 million and revenue of $2.8 billion. The company signed an Enterprise Master Automation Agreement with Walmart for an initial additional commitment of about $6.0 billion over several years, covering 25 U.S. regional distribution centers.

stories.title: FRA Pulls Funding for Amtrak’s Bridgeport Yard, Putting White Sox Stadium Plan on Hold
stories.summary: The Federal Railroad Administration withdrew a $572 million grant for Amtrak's proposed Midwest Maintenance Facility in Bridgeport, citing $400 million in unaccounted infrastructure costs and a shortfall in Amtrak's required non-federal contribution. This decision halts the relocation of Amtrak's 14th Street Yard, forcing investor Justin Ishbia and White Sox owner Jerry Reinsdorf to revisit their stadium plans.

stories.title: STM ALKAN FPV Kamikaze Drone Enters Turkish Security Forces Inventory
stories.summary: STM delivered its ALKAN FPV kamikaze drone to Turkish security forces after completing acceptance tests. The system features a 10-kilometre mission range, 140 km/h speed, and fiber-optic control to resist electronic jamming.

stories.title: SANY Advances Toward an AI-Native Robotics Future at bauma CHINA 2026
stories.summary: SANY unveiled its intelligent capabilities at bauma CHINA 2026, showcasing the industry's first cab-less 100-tonne autonomous battery-electric mining truck, the SKT165Ei. The company also introduced SanVIST, an intelligent connectivity platform featuring the SANY Neo AI agent for project management and repair diagnosis.

stories.title: Safety Zone; Pasquotank River Harbor, Elizabeth City, NC
stories.summary: The Coast Guard is establishing a temporary safety zone on the Pasquotank River at Elizabeth City, NC, to protect personnel, vessels, and the marine environment from an over-the-water drone display. Entry into the zone is prohibited unless specifically authorized by the Captain of the Port, Sector North Carolina, or their designated representative.

stories.title: Zelenskiy confirms Ukrainian drone strike on Russian ship in Gulf of Finland
stories.summary: Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskiy confirmed his country was responsible for Saturday’s drone strike on a Russian cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland. Norwegian defence minister Tore Sandvik said Ukraine must do these actions within the rules of international law.

stories.title: New Vertical Powertrain Center for the Valo eVTOL Unveiled in Bristol
stories.summary: Vertical Aerospace announced that its new Vertical Powertrain Center in Bristol is finalized and ready for equipment installation. The 30,000-square-foot facility, scheduled to kick off operations by next year, will be dedicated to electric and hybrid-electric powertrain engineering, system integration, and battery testing.

stories.title: Africa Corps runs Mali’s long-range drone war with Russian systems
stories.summary: Russia’s Africa Corps operates Shahed-type and Lancet drones in Mali’s north, with Bellingcat and Jeune Afrique geolocating strikes on Inafarak and Talahandak in July. Human Rights Watch reports 49 airstrikes killed 89 civilians between April and August 2026, more than double the previous year.

Drone detection system developer Pai Defence raises $5 million in funding
stories.summary: Defense startup Pai Defence raised $5 million in pre-seed funding led by Gardar Venture Capital. The British-Ukrainian company, which uses artificial intelligence (AI) to develop drone detection technology, emerged from stealth mode alongside the announcement.

stories.summary: Researchers published a study in Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence showing that standard oversampling methods for autonomous vehicle crash data create 76.2 percent overlapping candidate pools. Their new RA-MDST algorithm achieved 100 percent unique synthetic records but did not improve linear classifier accuracy.

Mexico’s Navy Advances Domestic Drone Technology
stories.summary: Mexico’s Ministry of the Navy (SEMAR) is developing unmanned aerial vehicles, including the SPARTAAM 88 and SPARTAAM 200, to expand maritime surveillance. The SPARTAAM 88 offers eight hours of flight autonomy and a 100km range, while the SPARTAAM 200 adds vertical takeoff and landing capabilities.

stories.title: Ukraine Plans to Double Drone Supplies and Triple Deep Strikes
stories.summary: Ukraine plans to double its drone supplies and more than triple its long-range strike capabilities next year, according to Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara. The UK pledged over 1,000 long-range strike drones in a $342 million package, while Norway committed $300 million for Ukrainian drone procurement.

stories.title: Amazon Jacksonville Drones Before Christmas if FAA Agrees: Councilman
stories.summary: City Councilman Randy White told Action News Jax that Amazon could begin Prime Air drone deliveries on Jacksonville’s Westside before Christmas if the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) approves. An Amazon spokesperson told the station the company is ready to go, contingent on FAA approval.

stories.title: First phase of $250m Hudson-Bergen Light Rail enhancement package funded
stories.summary: The New Jersey Transit board authorised $65.6m for the first phase of a $250m five-year capital investment programme for the 33 km Hudson-Bergen Light Rail line. The initial funding supports an overhaul of 52 light rail vehicles, infrastructure works in the Weehawken and Bergenline tunnels, technology upgrades, and lift modernisation at three stops.

stories.title: Volatus Wins Scheduled Drone Cargo Contract With Logistics Firm
stories.summary: Volatus Aerospace signed a contract to fly scheduled drone cargo runs for a major North American logistics company, moving shipments between two of the customer’s sites. The company will use its Canary drone, which carries 5 kg up to 30 km, flown from its control centre in Vaughan, Ontario, with up to six round trips per operating day.

stories.summary: German-Ukrainian company Quantum WIY Industries (QWI) hailed the outcome of recent combat testing using its Spys interceptor against Russia’s Geran-5 jet-powered one-way attack drone. Quantum Systems announced on 23 November that this was another successful interception by Spys in ongoing efforts to counter Russia’s Geran systems.

stories.summary: Nuro began driverless testing of Lucid Gravity robotaxis in Palo Alto, Mountain View, Los Altos, and Sunnyvale, using a fleet of more than 100 vehicles. The public launch, originally promised for 2026, is now expected in Q1 2027.

stories.title: A2Z Enters U.S. Drone First Responder Market with Forsyth County Deployment
stories.summary: A2Z Drone Delivery announced on November 18 that the Forsyth County Sheriff’s Office in North Carolina established the nation’s first A2Z AirDock network. The system includes three automated docking stations and Longtail Patrol drones serving up to 200 square miles around Winston-Salem, delivering payloads up to 8.8 pounds.

stories.title: Security Guard Baffled by Driverless Car Moving All Night
stories.summary: A security guard in China watched an electric vehicle reverse and maneuver around a parking garage throughout their night shift after its automatic parking function activated 868 times. The incident was linked to Huawei's Qiankun Intelligent Driving Open competition, with reports suggesting a possible technical glitch or repeated remote activation.

stories.title: MBTA Green Line modernization project advances to next phase of federal grant pipeline
stories.summary: The Federal Transit Administration approved the Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority's Green Line Transformation Core Capacity Program to enter the engineering phase of the Capital Investment Grants program. This decision locks in a maximum federal funding share of $2.04 billion for the $4.08 billion modernization effort, which aims to increase capacity by 37% by the required completion date of June 14, 2038.

stories.title: US Army demonstrates autonomous drone swarm attack from R3NEGADE robot in Germany
stories.summary: The US Army Combat Capabilities Development Command (DEVCOM) conducted a live-fire demonstration at Grafenwöhr Training Area in Germany, where a swarm of drones launched from an R3NEGADE unmanned ground vehicle autonomously attacked designated targets without human intervention. Soldiers from the 173rd Airborne Brigade operated FPV drones during the event, with one drone dropping smoke munitions before the autonomous attack.

stories.title: Germany Commits €34 Million to Ukrainian Drone Production
stories.summary: German Federal Minister of Defence Boris Pistorius announced on November 24 that Germany will provide approximately €34 million to establish domestic production of Ukrainian reconnaissance drones. TAF Industries and Wingcopter Security & Defence will manufacture the BABKA drone in Germany, initially supplying the Ukrainian Armed Forces.

stories.title: Beyond the Battlefield: Bringing Ukrainian Drone Innovation to Canada
stories.summary: Canadian drone manufacturer Draganfly signed two memoranda of understanding with TAF Industries and DOD Solution on November 20, 2026, at the Canadian Embassy in Kyiv. The agreements focus on producing Ukrainian unmanned systems in Canada and integrating DOD Solution’s AURA AI platform for GPS-denied environments.

stories.title: UK announces drone identification and tracking trial for London
stories.summary: The UK government announced a nearly GBP 2 million trial in London to equip police with technology that detects drones’ digital ‘number plates’ to improve identification and tracking. The Department for Transport said the measures aim to boost safe drone operations for medical and shopping deliveries while addressing illegal flights around public events.

stories.title: AI-powered robots assist humans in hazardous environments.
stories.summary: Soft robotics and artificial intelligence (AI) are emerging as new avenues for automation in manufacturing businesses. Companies can start with strenuous tasks, handling perishable products, or inspecting hazardous areas, then evaluate the effectiveness before expanding.

stories.title: SoftBank acquires Marc Raibert’s Robotics and AI Institute
stories.summary: SoftBank completed its acquisition of the Robotics and AI Institute from Hyundai Motor Group, with financial terms undisclosed. The Cambridge, Mass.-based institute, founded by Marc Raibert in 2022 with more than $400 million in initial funding, currently has 24 open positions across offices in Cambridge and Zurich, Switzerland.

stories.title: Can Counter-Drone Demand Strengthen Northrop Grumman's Growth?
Amtrak Ridership Surges to Record 37.1 Million
stories.summary: Amtrak reported 37.1 million customer trips in Fiscal Year 2026, marking its third consecutive year of record performance. The company also surpassed $4 billion in total operating revenue for the first time in its history.

stories.title: Embention Launches Veronte 4x 2.2 Flight Computer for UAS, eVTOL
stories.summary: Embention launched the Veronte Autopilot 4x 2.2, a triple-redundant flight control computer for defense drones, civil drones, and eVTOL aircraft. The new unit offers ten times the processing power and memory of the 4x 1.8, features dissimilar processors, and is designed for DAL A certification.

stories.title: Semi-autonomous ship defense system detects, tracks, and downs jet drone at sea
stories.summary: ASELSAN destroyed a jet-powered drone during a live-fire demonstration off Türkiye’s northern coast using its GÖKDENİZ naval air defense system. The system automatically detects and tracks targets, with operators authorizing firing through one button press, and also supports a fully autonomous mode and a containerized version for commercial vessels.

stories.title: How Drones Are Becoming Environmental Intelligence Platforms in Offshore Operations
stories.summary: The commercial drone industry is shifting from providing aerial images to delivering environmental intelligence by integrating artificial intelligence, onboard computing, and advanced sensors. This evolution allows drones to function as mobile sensor platforms that identify anomalies, track environmental changes, and support decision-making in offshore operations.

stories.title: Arrive AI and Electric Jet Aircraft Demonstrate Drone Readiness and Counter-UAS Potential at Camp Atterbury
stories.summary: Arrive AI and Electric Jet Aircraft demonstrated at Camp Atterbury in Indiana how an Arrive Point can store, charge, and launch an ArcSpear jet drone. The companies are exploring how this containerized system may support future counter-UAS missions.

also.title: Arrive AI Launches A Jet Drone From A Delivery Box At Camp Atterbury

stories.title: The Government-Approved Blind Spot Complicating the Security of America’s Low Altitude Airspace
stories.summary: Federal rules allow manned aircraft flying under visual flight rules in uncontrolled airspace, which comprises approximately 96 percent of America’s low-altitude airspace, to operate without ADS-B Out or a flight plan. This legal silence creates a plausibility gap that prevents low-altitude air domain awareness systems from distinguishing lawful aircraft from illegitimate threats.

stories.title: President Zelenskyy calls meeting on countering Russian jet-powered drones
stories.summary: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy held a meeting on 23 November with the Staff of the Supreme Commander-in-Chief to discuss protection against Russian jet-powered drones in 2026 and 2027. He stated that Ukraine needs more F-16s and Gripens, with the latter expected in January, and plans to sign contracts for additional interceptors.

stories.title: US Marines Bring Lessons From Ukraine’s Drone War to Australia
stories.summary: US Marines trialed 10 Neros Archer first-person-view attack drones and Tactical Resupply Unmanned Aircraft Systems during a seven-month rotation in Australia, adapting to Ukraine’s combat experience. In one exercise, a cargo drone delivered a refrigerated container carrying simulated blood over approximately 2.4 kilometers.

also.title: Ukraine Brings Frontline Drone Lessons to US-Led Drills With NATO Allies

stories.title: Drone-as-a-Service Creating a Powerful New Growth Market as Contract Opportunities Multiply
stories.summary: ZenaTech announced three new Mid-Atlantic transportation survey contracts in November 2026, bringing its annual transportation projects to eight and approximately $503,000 in contract revenue. The company also reported a consolidated contracted revenue backlog of more than C$20 million and recent contract awards totaling approximately US$1.8 million across solar, transportation, and oil and gas sectors.

stories.title: Pentagon holds major talks with GM and Ford to produce drone parts
stories.summary: The Pentagon is in talks with General Motors, Ford, and Magna International to mass-manufacture drones, with firms potentially supplying actuators, engines, sensors, and lidar. GM is considering building drone motors, though no deals have been finalized.

also.title: Pentagon reportedly in talks with GM, Ford to scale US military drone production

Pentagon seeks to enlist US automakers in military drone production push

stories.title: MARSS wins $16m contract for counter-drone systems in Middle East
stories.summary: MARSS secured a $16m contract to supply counter-uncrewed aerial system protection for sites of national strategic importance across the Middle East. The company will integrate its NiDAR Command and Control system, with work commencing immediately and full deployment targeted for completion by 2027.

stories.title: Dinner Comes Down on a Cable: Uber Eats Launches U.S. Drone Deliveries That Fly at Up to 113 km/h and Hover About 100 Meters Above the Ground While Lowering Meals to Customers
Modern Metropolis trains enter service on Cairo metro Line 1
stories.summary: Alstom Metropolis trains have begun entering service on the 44 km Cairo metro Line 1, which serves 2.5 million passengers daily. The €876m contract awarded by the National Authority for Tunnels in November 2021 covers 55 nine-car trainsets and eight years of maintenance.

stories.title: Police Say an Indiana Woman Tested at 0.14 After Her ‘Self-Driving’ Tesla Hit I-70 Work-Zone Arrow Boards — Now She Faces a Felony
stories.summary: State police say a 2016 Tesla was in self-driving mode when it ran into two lit arrow boards in an Interstate 70 work zone in Vigo County, Ind., around 10:30 p.m. on Thursday, Nov. 19. The case filed the next morning in Vigo Superior Court 5 is a felony case.

stories.title: Tesla Markets Full Self-Driving to Older Adults, Experts Warn Risks
stories.summary: Tesla promoted Full Self-Driving to older adults, with CEO Elon Musk stating in July that the technology enables safer mobility for senior citizens. Since June 2025, the company reported nearly 2,400 incidents involving its advanced driver-assistance systems, including 24 fatalities, while approximately 1.7 million vehicles currently use the feature for a monthly fee of $99.

stories.title: Joby Aviation Stock: Can Dubai Rescue the Air Taxi Pioneer?
stories.summary: Joby Aviation plans its first passenger air taxi operations in Dubai before the end of 2026, securing six years of exclusive rights from the Roads and Transport Authority. The company reported third-quarter revenue of $55.1 million and a net loss of $211.8 million, while holding $2.2 billion in cash and investments.

stories.title: Flytrex launches multi-vendor drone delivery service in Denton
stories.summary: Flytrex launched a multi-vendor drone delivery service in Denton on Nov. 20, delivering food and beverages from local businesses to residents. The company’s drones deliver loads of up to 8.8 pounds to households within a 2.5-mile radius of the launch site at 2315 Colorado Blvd.

stories.title: Lithium-Ion Batteries for Industrial Robots Support Faster Production and More Reliable Automation
stories.summary: Manufacturers are adopting lithium-ion batteries for industrial robots to achieve faster production and reliable automation. The technology offers high energy density, lightweight construction, and faster charging times, which minimize downtime and support continuous operations in manufacturing, automotive, and distribution sectors.

stories.title: Terra Industries pitches drone ecosystem for Africa at AFRIDEX 2026
stories.summary: Terra Industries presented its networked drone and ground vehicle ecosystem at AFRIDEX 2026 in Lagos, announcing plans to open a 34,000 square foot factory in Accra, Ghana, by the fourth quarter of 2026. The company aims to produce 50,000 aerial systems annually by 2028 and create 120 engineering jobs, expanding its defense and commercial operations across Africa.

stories.title: TAF Industries and Wingcopter Security & Defence receive € 34 million for mass production of Ukrainian reconnaissance drones in Germany
stories.summary: German Federal Minister of Defence Boris Pistorius announced that Germany will provide approximately €34 million to set up domestic production of the BABKA reconnaissance drone for Ukraine. The drones will be produced by TAF Industries and Wingcopter Security & Defence through a joint venture established earlier this year in Germany.

stories.title: NVIDIA Modules Used in Multiple Types of Russian AI-Powered Drones and Missiles
stories.summary: Ukrainian specialists found civilian NVIDIA Jetson Orin modules in Russian Molniya, V2U, Shahed-136, and S-71M Monochrome weapons. In Zaporizhzhia, a Molniya drone independently selected a target, killing three people. NVIDIA confirmed the components are civilian products not sold directly to Russia.

stories.title: T4 Robotics Explores Drone Command-and-Control Software Built on Video Game Technology
stories.summary: T4 Robotics announced its intent to develop a drone command-and-control software platform that adapts video game technology to integrate with existing military systems. The company plans an initial research and development phase with a Ukrainian operating partner to map field usage and establish technical requirements before committing to a defined product program.

stories.title: Russian drone attacks energy workers' vehicle in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast
stories.summary: A Russian FPV drone hit a DTEK crew's vehicle near a frontline village in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast on 23 November while workers inspected power lines. None of the workers were injured, though the vehicle was damaged.

stories.title: Could Texas get a high speed rail line?
stories.summary: State Representative John Bucy III filed House Bill 270 on November 9, proposing a privately operated high-speed rail line along the Interstate 35 corridor connecting Dallas, Waco, Austin, and San Antonio. The legislation would require the Texas Department of Transportation to enter into an agreement with a private company to build, maintain, and operate trains capable of reaching speeds of at least 110 mph.

also.title: Texas high-speed rail bill skips Houston. What about the line to Dallas?

stories.title: Keeta Drone Pitches Dubai Villa Drops, But Sets No Start Date
stories.summary: Keeta Drone, the drone delivery business of China’s Meituan, flew a package from the Sobha Hartland development to the Museum of the Future on Wednesday, November 18, during Dubai Future Week. The flight was the pitch for a new service that would lower orders on a cable at villas in Nad Al Sheba and Sobha Hartland, with no pickup kiosk involved.

also.title: Keeta Drone floats new 20km drone delivery route in Dubai

stories.title: Amazon Site Owner Takes North Myrtle Beach Drone Pad Denial to Court
stories.summary: ExchangeRight Essential Income 11 DST filed a 12-page appeal in Horry County Court of Common Pleas on November 19, challenging North Myrtle Beach's 6-0 denial of a 13,627-square-foot drone launch pad. The owner requested pre-litigation mediation, arguing the city lacked site-specific data to justify the rejection of the facility at 8651 Water Tower Road.

stories.title: Indian-Korean joint venture to produce ‘Make in India’ metro trains and traction systems
stories.summary: Jupiter Wagons Ltd and Woojin Industrial Systems announced an 80:20 joint venture and technology transfer agreement to produce metro trains and propulsion systems in India.

also.title: Woojin to Form Local JV With India's Jupiter Wagons, Entering Electric Train and Propulsion System Markets

stories.title: Colombia’s counter-drone ambitions face an evolving threat
stories.summary: Colombia's Ministry of Defence confirmed on 9 November that the National Anti-Drone Shield project lacks consolidated financing, technical viability, and guaranteed resources for 2026 implementation, with no acquisition contract awarded. The programme, announced in January 2026 with an investment of more than COP 6 trillion, aims to protect military and police units as well as civilians.

stories.title: Amazon Drone Crashes into Michigan Garage, FAA Launches Probe
stories.summary: The FAA launched an investigation after an Amazon delivery drone crashed into a residential garage in Huntington Woods, Michigan, on November 20. The aircraft struck a fiber cable and garage before becoming entangled in power lines, damaging a propeller, while the NTSB gathers information without yet deciding on a separate probe.

also.title: Amazon Drone Video Shows Six People Lowering It as FAA Investigates

stories.title: Aero Sentinel Claims SENIX Flew 10 Miles Out, 60% Past Its Spec
stories.summary: Aero Sentinel announced on November 23 that its SENIX drone flew a 20-mile (32 km) round trip without external antennas, a range 60% longer than the 6.2-mile (10 km) communications range listed in its November 11 launch release. The company, controlled by Veloryx, stated the flight broke its intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance record, though Defence Blog noted the figures could not be independently verified and no location was provided.

also.title: Backpack-sized tactical drone flies 10 miles without ground antennas, sets range record

stories.title: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted and destroyed Houthi drone aimed at southern Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: The Saudi-led coalition intercepted and destroyed a Houthi drone aimed at southern Saudi Arabia, reporting no casualties or damage. Market pricing puts the odds of a formal closure of Saudi airspace by December 31 at 5.5%.

stories.title: Romania air raid alert: NATO jets scrambled near Ukraine border
stories.summary: Romania declared an air raid alert in Tulcea County on Saturday morning, prompting two Spanish F/A-18 fighter jets to scramble from Mihail Kogălniceanu air base. The alert was lifted at 11:51 local time after the Ministry of Defence confirmed no airspace violations, though Ukrainian officials reported Russian drones attacked nearby Izmail.

stories.title: Poland Convenes National Security Committee Meeting Following Airspace Violation
stories.summary: Poland convened its Council of Ministers’ Committee on National Security on November 24 to discuss airspace violations and potential NATO support. The meeting addressed the possibility of deploying early-warning aircraft and establishing a permanent U.S. military base on Polish territory.

stories.title: Ukraine and Norway boost air defence against attack drones
stories.summary: Ukraine and Norway expanded air defence cooperation by delivering the DESNA counter-unmanned aerial system, a joint development between Kongsberg and a Ukrainian partner. The Norwegian government also announced a purchase of air defence missiles for approximately 22 billion kroner to protect combat air bases and critical infrastructure.

also.title: Ukraine and Norway Unveil DESNA Anti-Drone System, Already Protecting the Front

stories.title: Germany To Get Ukraine's Delta Drone Software, Not Its Combat Data
stories.summary: Ukrainian Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara and German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius signed a letter of intent in Berlin on November 23, making Germany the first country to access Delta battlefield software. The agreement excludes Ukraine’s combat data, with a separate agreement to follow for technical and legal conditions.

stories.title: Japan to amend law regarding the investigation of self-driving car accidents
stories.summary: The government plans to submit a bill to next year’s ordinary parliamentary session starting in January to have the Japan Transport Safety Board (JTSB) investigate self-driving car accidents. The JTSB would investigate accidents that resulted in death or serious injury caused by vehicles equipped with Level 4 autonomous driving technology.

stories.title: Poland blames Russia for drone incursion as fears grow of Ukraine conflict escalation
stories.summary: Poland blamed Russia for a drone incursion, citing growing fears of escalation in the Ukraine conflict.

stories.title: ARX Robotics UGV Links Into British Army AI Targeting Network
stories.summary: ARX Robotics integrated its GEREON uncrewed ground vehicles into the British Army’s ASGARD network during Exercise Haraka Storm in Kenya. The company states the link made the Army’s sense-decide-effect process 10 times faster ahead of 4 Brigade’s deployment to NATO’s eastern flank.

stories.title: Sudan’s army downs fourth FH-95 drone in a week over Kordofan
stories.summary: The Sudanese Armed Forces shot down a Chinese-made FH-95 drone east of Wad Banda in West Kordofan on November 7, 2026, marking the fourth such interception in seven days. The army described the aircraft as hostile but did not identify the operator, while ground forces simultaneously advanced toward Al-Khuwei and claimed control of Umm Marahik.

stories.title: Lockheed Martin Advances Robotic Welding Technology for In-Space Construction
stories.summary: Lockheed Martin announced details of its JOINS program on November 23, 2026, which will test laser beam and friction stir welding techniques aboard the International Space Station. NASA lists November 2026 as the estimated launch period and March 2027 as the expected demonstration date for the project, which is backed by a NASA Funded Space Act Agreement valued at approximately $9.1 million.

stories.title: Germany to keep closer eye on DB InfraGO under new performance agreement
stories.summary: Transport minister Steffen Bilger unveiled a draft five-year performance agreement for DB InfraGO, tying more than €80bn in rail network funding to binding targets with fines for non-compliance. Rail associations welcomed the tighter control but warned the legislation did not fully address rising track access charges.

stories.title: MS Dhoni Backed Garuda Aerospace Hosts Israeli Defence Sector Companies for Joint Development of Technology
stories.summary: Garuda Aerospace hosted 15 Israeli delegates at its Chennai facility to explore joint technology development and local manufacturing. The visit included live demonstrations of the Droni, Jawan, Kisan, and Delivery drones, with discussions focused on technology transfer and strengthening India's indigenous drone ecosystem.

stories.title: DroneShield Achieves Initial Operational Capability for Layered Counter-UAS Solution Supporting JIATF-401
U.S. Navy’s Key Sigonella Air Base in Italy Shut Down After Unidentified Drone Sightings
Norwegian Army tests drone lessons in battalion exercise Viking Ymer
stories.summary: The Norwegian Army is running Viking Ymer, a two-sided battalion exercise shaped by drone warfare in Ukraine, with His Majesty The King's Guard and the Telemark Battalion as opposing forces. The Army Weapons School plans and coordinates the exercise, which is fully instrumented with laser and sensor systems.

stories.title: Morocco expands to 5 foreign drone suppliers and local production
stories.summary: Morocco expanded its drone suppliers to six countries in 2024 and 2025, including local production by Aerodrive Engineering. BlueBird opened a SpyX plant at Benslimane in November 2025, while Baykar registered a subsidiary there in December 2024.

stories.title: Adaptive Communication Theory Framework Proposed for Autonomous Vehicle
stories.summary: Researchers published a theoretical framework in Design Science that conceptualizes autonomous vehicle-pedestrian interactions as adaptive social communications. The study reviewed 20 interface prototypes and found that none explicitly grounded design in communication theory or established bidirectional feedback loops to confirm pedestrian acknowledgment of vehicle intent.

stories.title: Science City Targets $18.2B Economy, Expands Autonomous Vehicle Testing and Logistics
stories.summary: The Western (Chongqing) Science City High-Tech Zone announced plans to expand autonomous vehicle testing and logistics, targeting a 60 billion yuan new energy vehicle and motorcycle sector by 2030. The zone aims to produce 200,000 new energy commercial vehicles and 3 million motorcycles annually, while developing demonstration routes for autonomous logistics vehicles.

stories.title: Infineon adapts automotive and industrial chip technologies to advance the development of humanoid robots
stories.summary: Infineon Technologies is adapting its automotive and industrial semiconductor technologies for humanoid robots, with functional safety, dexterity, and power efficiency emerging as key development priorities. Allan Frederiksen, Technology and Innovation Officer at Infineon, told DIGITIMES during Embedded World India 2026 in Bengaluru that a timeline for significant production will develop with market needs.

stories.title: Poland did not shoot down the Russian drone after it turned toward Ukraine.
stories.summary: Polish forces withheld fire on a Russian drone that briefly entered their airspace during an overnight attack on western Ukraine, citing risks to civilians. The Operational Command of the Polish Armed Forces stated that authorization to destroy the target had been given, but they decided not to use weapons due to the potential threat to civilians after the drone turned east.

stories.title: Japan’s Atom Secures $28.3M in Bank Credit to Expand Humanoid Robot Production
stories.summary: Japanese humanoid robotics startup Atom signed loan agreements totaling about $28.3 million with Mizuho Bank, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp., and Mitsubishi UFJ Bank to support physical AI development and mass production. The company plans to use the financing to build a GPU computing cluster and manufacturing infrastructure, targeting 200 annual robot deliveries by 2027 and 10,000 by 2030.

stories.title: Military Brings in Wearable Robots and Drone Stations, Using Civilian Innovations to Transform Combat Power and Barracks Life
stories.summary: The Ministry of National Defense designated 36 commercial products and six defense-sector innovation products on the 24th to enhance combat capabilities and barracks life. The ministry aims to adapt to troop reductions and help small and medium enterprises access public procurement.

stories.title: Tram track supplied for renewal of busy Basel junction
stories.summary: Czech turnout manufacturer DT Výhybkárna a Strojírna produced six turnouts and three crossings weighing more than 50 tonnes for the renewal of a double-track triangular junction near the Heiliggeistkirche church in Basel.

stories.title: Robotaxi boom offers SK On's US factories a path to recovery
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor CEO Jose Munoz said the company plans to deliver Ioniq 5-based robotaxis to Waymo this month. Some foreign media reports suggest Hyundai Motor could deliver up to 50,000 Ioniq 5 robotaxis to Waymo by 2028.

stories.title: Taiwan lawmakers approve first-year funding for Albatross II military drone production
stories.summary: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan approved NT$1.675 billion (US$50.96 million) in first-year funding for the Albatross II military drone, clearing the way for initial production. The domestically developed intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) drone is being developed by the National Chung-Shan Institute of Science and Technology.

stories.title: Bullet train trials scheduled for May 2027 on Surat-Bilimora section in Gujarat, minister confirms
stories.summary: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw confirmed that India's first bullet train trials will commence in May 2027 on the 50-kilometre Surat-Bilimora section of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail Corridor. The B-28 train, designed for speeds up to 280 kilometres per hour, will conduct initial testing after signalling work is expected to finish by January 2027.

also.title: Bullet train trials to begin in May 2027, first phase likely to open in Q4: Ashwini Vaishnaw — here’s what we know
Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail Trial Runs Set for May 2027 on Gujarat Segment
India moves closer to first bullet train trials

stories.title: AgiBot Deploys Robots on Smartphone Production Lines
stories.summary: AgiBot struck a strategic partnership with Lens Technology to deploy dozens of Genie G2 robots across smartphone testing lines. The robots will handle automated loading, unloading, and equipment interaction for MMI, ANT, CAM, and CAMCV sequences, aiming to build a standardized template for 3C smartphone testing.

stories.title: India successfully tests JWALA MK-1 mobile counter-drone system
stories.summary: IG Defence reported successful tests of the JWALA MK-1 mobile micro-missile system at the Pokhran firing range in Rajasthan, India. The system detects and neutralizes unmanned aerial vehicles up to 5 km away using an artificial intelligence-based GRID complex for autonomous control.

stories.title: Cosine Robots Raises Rs 22.36 Cr Led By Avaana Capital
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based Cosine Robots raised Rs 22.36 crore ($2.4 million) in a round led by Avaana Capital, with participation from WEH Ventures and angel investors. The company plans to use the capital to establish a dedicated research and development and production facility, expand its engineering team, and accelerate the development of its robotics motion systems.

also.title: Cosine Robots Raises Rs 22.36 Crore to Build Robotic Actuators in India

stories.title: KG Steel Deploys Korean-Made Humanoid Robot at Steel Plant
stories.summary: KG Steel introduced ALICE M2, a humanoid robot developed by Aerobot, at its Dangjin plant to automate the gripping, transport, and stacking of inner-diameter rings. The company targets a success rate of more than 90% and more than 50 consecutive operations without stopping.

stories.title: Using Foldable Smartphone Technology to Make 'Robot Hands'... Daesung Hi-Tech Secures a New Growth Engine
stories.summary: Daesung Hi-Tech will deliver at least 100 industrial and outdoor autonomous mobile robots to three domestic robotics companies this year and plans to increase production to at least 300 units next year. The company expects robot-related revenue next year to reach at least four times this year's level as it diversifies into contract development and manufacturing of complete robots.

stories.title: Drone-Related Flight Restrictions Disrupt Russian Air Travel as About 60 Foreign Airlines Keep Serving the Country
stories.summary: Repeated drone-related flight restrictions across Russia have disrupted travel for roughly 60 foreign airlines from 37 countries, causing delays and crew scheduling issues. Aviation platform RunAvia reported that airports imposed takeoff and landing restrictions 73 times at 28 airports from Nov. 16 to 22, nearly twice as often as in the same week a year earlier.

stories.title: Hong Kong to Impose Four-Day Airspace Restrictions, Banning Drones, Kites and Balloons, for Interpol General Assembly
stories.summary: Hong Kong police established a temporary restricted flying zone from November 30 to December 3 for the Interpol General Assembly, banning drones, kites, and balloons across the city. The city is hosting the assembly for the first time, with the conference taking place at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai.

stories.title: Drone in Approach Path Forces Two Aircraft to Abort Landings at Hamburg Airport; 45-Year-Old Under Investigation
stories.summary: Police seized a drone and its remote control after it forced two aircraft to abort landings at Hamburg Airport on Sunday afternoon. They are investigating a 45-year-old man on suspicion of endangering air traffic, noting the drone flew at an altitude of about 120 meters.

stories.title: Archer Aviation and Formula 1 Announce Multi-Year Partnership to Bring Midnight eVTOL Air Taxis to Grand Prix Events
stories.summary: Archer Aviation and Formula 1 announced a multi-year partnership to bring Archer's Midnight eVTOL aircraft to select Grand Prix events across the US, Middle East, Asia and Europe. The partners plan to explore dedicated air taxi pick-up and drop-off locations at circuits, as well as the inclusion of air taxi services within Formula 1's hospitality and ticketing offerings.

also.title: Can Archer's Formula 1 Partnership Expand Its Air Taxi Market Reach?

stories.title: Exclusive: Freshly made European, American components found in Russian drones attacking Ukraine
stories.summary: Ukrainian intelligence found American and European components made in 2026 in a Russian Geran-4 drone shot down over Kyiv Oblast in mid-August. The drone contained nearly 100 non-Russian parts, including chips from CTS Corporation, Vishay Intertechnology, and STMicroelectronics, indicating Russia is obtaining newly made restricted Western technology through sanctions-evasion networks.

stories.title: Cleared for Takeoff as Florida's Flying Cars Near Reality
stories.summary: Florida became the first state to authorize 100% public funding for certain vertiport projects in April, while Archer Aviation announced plans for an electric air taxi network connecting Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Boca Raton, and West Palm Beach in December 2025.
